narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: tax is computed on `cents` instead of the discounted amount. Fixing.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Tax was computed on the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount, so orders with both a discount and a tax rate came out wrong. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead.

No other issues found. Nothing left to do.
